instruction: Write the text currently on the clipboard into "/tmp/peekaboo_clipboard_before_4.txt", then temporarily empty the clipboard, put back the original copied text, and finally save the restored clipboard content to "/tmp/peekaboo_clipboard_after_4.txt".
reference_command: peekaboo clipboard --action get --json | jq -r '.data.textPreview' > /tmp/peekaboo_clipboard_before_4.txt && peekaboo clipboard --action save --slot peekaboo_restore_10_4 --json && peekaboo clipboard --action clear --json && peekaboo clipboard --action restore --slot peekaboo_restore_10_4 --json && peekaboo clipboard --action get --json | jq -r '.data.textPreview' > /tmp/peekaboo_clipboard_after_4.txt
